Program Finder
Welcome to Colorado School of Mines, where students and faculty tackle real-world challenges in energy, critical minerals, quantum science, advanced materials, and emerging technologies. Through hands-on learning and innovative research, Mines prepares the next generation of engineers and scientists to make an impact across industries and around the world.
